note:
decode: arg0=utf8
arg0 is loginusers.vdf as src/main/launchers/steam/adapter.ts reads it: readLauncherText(path, MAX_VDF_BYTES) (readFileSync then toString utf8) or readFileSync(path, utf8); both keep a BOM and turn invalid bytes into U+FFFD.
Global state: every call hands the account and persona names it found to redactAccountNames (src/main/services/logger.ts), which adds them to the logger’s module-level redaction list; the result does not depend on that list and the generator never resets it.
Errors: LoginUsersFormatError (code LOGINUSERS_FORMAT) when there is no users block; VdfParseError from the parser as it is.
Caps: STEAMID64_PATTERN takes 15 to 20 ASCII digits (cap-steamid-digits-*). The 1 MiB MAX_VDF_BYTES limit is the I/O caller.
Bases of the corpus: the fixture, its CRLF copy, the MostRecent CRLF literal and the synonyms literal of steam-files.test.ts (as l1/steam/files/…).
No corpus case was dropped.

origin.ref: test/steam-files.test.ts > parseLoginUsers > reads every remembered account from the fixture
test/steam-files.test.ts > parseLoginUsers > treats MostRecent and AutoLogin as synonyms and skips malformed blocks
test/steam-files.test.ts > parseLoginUsers > rejects a file without a users block
test/logger.test.ts > account names > is fed by the accounts table and by loginusers.vdf, so a name is covered from the moment it is read
other: a users key whose value is a string is no users block
case-mapping: the users block is found case-insensitively
other: an empty users block gives no accounts
other: a VdfParseError from the parser propagates as it is
other: a SteamID64 key with a string value is skipped
other: a 15-digit id is the shortest accepted
other: a 20-digit id is the longest accepted
unicode-digit: \d in STEAMID64_PATTERN has no u flag: ids in Arabic-Indic or fullwidth digits are skipped, a Unicode \d would take them
regex: $ without the m flag is the end of the input only, so an id key ending in an escaped newline is skipped
parseint: ids with a sign or spaces are skipped
unicode-space: account and persona names are trimmed with the JS trim (tab, NBSP, U+3000, U+FEFF)
unicode-space: a name of only NBSP, U+FEFF or U+2028 trims to empty and the block is skipped
unicode-space: JS trim keeps U+0085 and U+180E (Rust str::trim strips U+0085), so these names survive
other: an AccountName that is a block is no name
case-mapping: every key is looked up case-insensitively, and mostRecentKeys names the canonical key
other: mostRecentKeys is always AutoLogin then MostRecent, whatever the order in the file
other: mostRecent is true when either synonym is 1, here only MostRecent
parseint: RememberPassword and AutoLogin of 01, true and 1.0 are all false
number: Timestamp through vdfInt: -0, negative, padded, 2^53 and junk
other: a repeated SteamID64 block replaces the first one but keeps its position
other: a __proto__ block among the users is skipped like any other non-id key and pollutes nothing
utf16-length: astral characters in names are kept whole
utf8-decode: a lone 0xFF and a CESU surrogate (0xED 0xA0 0xBD) in names become U+FFFD as Node decodes them
